title: Analyzing the Impact of Fake News on the Anticipated Outcome of the 2024 Election Ahead of Time

bias_targets.methodology: Scraping North American political news articles using race-related keywords and annotating the texts to identify biased/fake phrases and provide debiased versions using a hybrid approach of GPT-3.5 and human verification.

Collecting news articles related to political discourse, categorizing them by political dimensions, and using Large Language Models combined with human expert review to annotate fake versus real news content.
Extracting and categorizing articles based on religion-related keywords to identify, annotate, and debias misleading phrases using an AI-assisted and human-verified annotation pipeline.
Filtering news articles using keywords related to gender and sexuality (e.g., gender equality) and annotating textual data to capture and debias misinformation.
